en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a steep cliffside walking path with a railing, running along a rocky wall through a dense coniferous forest. Below is a deep valley or gorge, and in the distance a church-like building with a tall spire rises above the trees. At the top of the image, red printed text gives the location, and there is a faint embossed postal mark on the right.
